metadata.Description:
Approved Remote Access Types
for more details - refer to Control statement
Approved Remote Access Types
1. Virtual Private Network (VPN)
2. Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
3. Secure Shell (SSH) for command-line access
4. Cloud-native identity-aware proxy services
Periodic Review and Auditing
1. Conduct monthly reviews of remote logs and patterns.
2. Generate quarterly reports on:
- Session limit violations
- Users frequently reaching maximum concurrent sessions
- Effectiveness of the current session limit policy
metadata.controlTitle: Maintain a list of approved remote access types, with continuous monitoring and periodic reviews to ensure compliance with access control policies.
